description: Free onboarding: register once to receive 2 free points, then pay tools with points instead of USDC. Requires an EIP-191 personal_sign over the message from get_a2a_registration_protocol plus a SHA-256 proof of work. Required arguments: wallet_address, nonce (32-byte lowercase hex), expires_at (unix seconds, <=300s ahead), signature, pow_counter. Example: {"wallet_address":"0xabc...40hex","nonce":"<64 lowercase hex>","expires_at":1790000000,"signature":"0x...","pow_counter":"12345"}. Optional inviter_code binds a referral. Clients that cannot sign or solve proof of work should call register_a2a_agent instead.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds, at most 300 seconds in the future

name: generate_a2a_invitation
